gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Unica One draws every line at a single thickness, so its tall display letters look cut from flat tape. Noto Sans Sinhala sets a dark, heavy band of lowercase, so give it a little extra size to let those curves breathe.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Noto Sans Soyombo has a sizable x-height and curves that stay open.  Unica One, with its commanding display voice and horizontals as thick as its verticals, sits above it like a bold sign over a quiet doorway.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Tight spacing between x-height and cap height gives Noto Sans Sundanese a compact, level look, with open-mouthed e crossbars. Unica One is the blunt marker-tipped shout; this body is the quiet talker.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Noto Sans Sunuwar has curves that leave daylight like an open loop of rope, plus short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies. And Unica One, flat and unmodulated in line weight, gives it a commanding, distinctive front.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nag: A very large lowercase eye and a stroke width that never wavers make Unica One instantly recognizable. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri follows with short ascenders and a tall x-height.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Unica One keeps horizontals exactly as thick as its verticals. Noto Sans Syriac adds tall, rounded bowls like blown glass bulbs and s shapes that turn easily, so the headline's firmness meets a softer, friendlier body.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-syriac-wes: Commanding, with every letter drawn in one constant line width, Unica One leads the page. Noto Sans Syriac Western holds its terminals far from the stroke body, and its small letters feel thick with height, like bundled cable, over a long read.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Noto Sans Tagalog reads with a texture where the middle zone dominates each line, and its curves keep generous gaps. And Unica One, with no thin strokes vanishing in glare, makes a bold, distinctive partner.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Noto Sans Tagbanwa keeps its curves open with clear gaps, and its lowercase fills most of the height. And Unica One does the headline work best, with no quill-like tapering anywhere in its commanding display shapes.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Distinctive is the word for Unica One, whose strokes resemble a bent paperclip, with a very large lowercase eye and visible daylight in every curve. Noto Sans Tai Le tapers out gently beside it.
